summary: Online research pass used to keep the next work focused on the riskiest unfinished evidence lane rather than more registries. The pressure is: exact attention baselines and serving/cache baselines have moved; a sparse-attention claim must beat current SDPA/FlexAttention/FlashAttention/vLLM/xFormers-style baselines under named-hardware receipts, not just a toy dense loop.

source_basis.label: Hugging Face Transformers offline mode
source_basis.observed_fact: Offline/firewalled Transformers use requires model files to be downloaded/cached ahead of time; snapshot_download is the recommended route for repository snapshots.
source_basis.cube_implication: Capture should load local/cache files only after snapshot preparation. Network download during evidence capture is a run-drift risk.

source_basis.label: Hugging Face Hub snapshot download guide
source_basis.observed_fact: snapshot_download/hf_hub_download dry-run reports commit hash, file name, size, cached status, and whether a file would be downloaded.
source_basis.cube_implication: Keep dry-run/materialization as a pre-capture step and preserve digest checks for large weights.

source_basis.label: PyTorch scaled_dot_product_attention API
source_basis.observed_fact: PyTorch exposes scaled_dot_product_attention as the core exact SDPA API with attention mask/dropout/causal/GQA options.
source_basis.cube_implication: The dense baseline must be a current SDPA/FlashAttention-backed baseline, not a hand-written quadratic reference alone.

source_basis.label: PyTorch FlexAttention documentation
source_basis.observed_fact: FlexAttention exposes BlockMask as a block-sparse attention mask representation.
source_basis.cube_implication: Any claimed sparse selector should be compared against compiler-supported block-sparse/flexible attention surfaces.

source_basis.label: PyTorch FlexAttention inference blog
source_basis.observed_fact: FlexAttention inference work supports GQA and PagedAttention-style inference concerns.
source_basis.cube_implication: The cube's selector receipts should include GQA and cache-layout compatibility, not just prefill rows.

source_basis.label: vLLM PagedAttention design
source_basis.observed_fact: vLLM's paged attention kernel is designed around paged KV caches and global-memory Q/K/V cache pointers.
source_basis.cube_implication: Selector/value-layout ideas must be measured against paged KV-cache serving patterns, not only local flat tensors.

source_basis.label: Hugging Face Transformers cache strategies
source_basis.observed_fact: Transformers documents DynamicCache, StaticCache, and QuantizedCache tradeoffs such as compile support and memory usage.
source_basis.cube_implication: Dynamic cache is right for trace semantics, but timing claims need separate cache-strategy baselines.

source_basis.label: FlashAttention GitHub README
source_basis.observed_fact: The FlashAttention project now describes FlashAttention-4 optimized for Hopper and Blackwell GPUs.
source_basis.cube_implication: Named-hardware timing must state GPU generation and compare against the exact installed attention backend.

source_basis.label: xFormers optimized operators docs
source_basis.observed_fact: xFormers documents optimized memory-efficient attention operators, attention biases, and partial attention surfaces.
source_basis.cube_implication: A sparse attention win has to survive against production-style memory-efficient and partial-attention operators.

priority_change: Keep capture local-only; materialization and download are pre-capture phases.
Promote no sparse performance claim until the baseline bracket includes current SDPA/FlexAttention/FlashAttention or installed-backend equivalents.
Treat vLLM/PagedAttention and cache-strategy pressure as required context for any decode/timing claim.
Use named-hardware receipts to distinguish trace semantics from performance claims.
